about: The tutor set (docs/plans/assistant.md Phase D): two hundred topic questions across the boards (NCERT for CBSE, Balbharati for MSBSHSE, NIOS), the grade bands (1–5, 6–8, 9–10, 11–12), the colleges and teachers, in en, hi and mr. Scored for correctness (keywords: at least half of `keywords` in an English answer; for hi and mr at least one of `keywords` or `localKeywords`), the citation (at least one, every cited chunk exists, a pupil's citations within two classes of the pupil's own) and the template's scale (questionShape: a definition short, an explanation with its check question, a why with reasons, all within their word limits). Correctness by keyword is a proxy; the Hindi and Marathi answers go to a speaker (R-14).
